form:FormGroup.label: Search Process Time To Idle
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long the search can go unused before it is stopped. Results already found are kept. Enter a duration such as 30s, 10m, 1h or 1d, or ISO 8601 such as PT10M.

form:FormGroup.label: Search Process Time To Live
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long after the search was created before it is stopped, whether or not it is in use. Results already found are kept. Enter a duration such as 10m, 1h or 1d, or ISO 8601 such as PT1H.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Duration from creation, e.g. 1h or PT1H.

tickbox:CustomCheckBox.label: Search Process Destroy On Tab Close
Search Process Destroy On Window Close

form:FormGroup.label: Store Time To Idle
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long the results can go unused before they are deleted. Enter a duration such as 30s, 10m, 1h or 1d, or ISO 8601 such as PT10M.

form:FormGroup.label: Store Time To Live
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long after the results were created before they are deleted, whether or not they are in use. Enter a duration such as 10m, 1h or 1d, or ISO 8601 such as P1D.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Duration from creation, e.g. 1d or P1D.
